mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.point_operation (id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_id, point_type_id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, actor_id, reason_code, correlation_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{memberId}, #{accountId}, #{pointTypeId}, #{operationType}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{actorId}, #{reasonCode}, #{correlationId}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_id, point_type_id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, actor_id, reason_code, correlation_id, status, response_json::text AS response_json, created_at, updated_at FROM loyalty.point_operation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
